assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: TerraFirma billboard illustration background, with typography to be overlaid later in code.
Input image: edit target and visual-style reference. Preserve its chrome Operator character design, bold ink line illustration, bone paper, burnt-orange Mars, and fine technical grid visual language. Simplify the layout dramatically.
Canvas: very wide landscape, exactly 3:1 aspect ratio, ideally 3000 x 1000 pixels. Full bleed, no margins or frame.
Composition: chest-up Operator occupies ONLY leftmost 21% of width, cropped at left and bottom edges. All of its clothing and head stay in this left zone. A modest line-illustrated excavator occupies ONLY the rightmost 20% of width, at bottom right. Small burnt-orange Mars arc tucked behind figure at far left, and a smaller orange horizon wedge at far right. ONE tiny rocket on the distant far-right horizon, smaller than the excavator cab, never in foreground. Engineering grid only at lower left and lower right, confined behind the figure and machine. The entire middle from x=24% through x=77%, top to bottom, is completely clear, uniform flat bone #EFEBE4 negative space, with no skyline, lines, illustrations, gradient, haze, texture or objects. This is an empty typography-safe field. Clean cut silhouettes where peripheral imagery meets the empty center.
Palette: flat bone #EFEBE4, deep ink #14182A, restrained burnt orange #CF572D. Chrome rendered in crisp cream, white, ink linework, minimal gray. Same refined industrial-futurist, Texas-built style as the original, but clearer and less crowded.
Text: NONE. Remove EVERY existing letter, word, slogan, logo, sign, label, numeral, wordmark panel, badge and neon tube. No lettering anywhere, including clothing, machinery and rocket. Add no text, no watermark, no decorative writing.

Subject edit: Retain the Texas cowboy chrome Operator helmet, cowboy hat, and practical scarf. Make the body compact enough to fit leftmost 21%, with hat entirely visible inside that left zone. Keep it recognizable and detailed. No extra costume props. No additional people or foreground spacecraft.
